entities.title: Run the browser locally
entities.summary: Serve the folder and open it with a repository's address.
entities.verify: The folder tree and the first folder appear, and the browser's console shows no errors.

entities.title: Check this description
entities.summary: Run both validators from the repository root after changing a .dev file here.
entities.when: After changing any file in this .dev folder, Actors/ or the schemas.
entities.verify: The first prints what it validated with no error; the second ends with 0 problems.
entities.details: In this repository the validators sit at `Agents/`, not `Meta/Agents/` as in a repository that installs them, so pass the repository root (`.`) as the argument.

entities.title: Publish a new version
entities.summary: Copy the page to icelander.net and deploy it.
entities.when: When the owner wants a change live.
steps: Copy software-system-browser/index.html to site/apps/architecture-browser.html in the icelander.net repository
Deploy icelander.net as that repository describes
